integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof with two runnable exact-arithmetic verifiers; current review is self-review only; no independent audit or external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only nonzero rank-one, weight-zero operators on the exterior algebra of two generators over finite fields F_(2^e), e>=2. Earlier F_2 rank-one counts are already published. No general statement about higher ranks, other weights, or higher exterior dimensions. Closest 2013 paper was available by abstract only, leaving residual literature risk.
title: Six rank-one Rota–Baxter symmetry classes over characteristic-two extension fields
